about_p1: I suppose their work is good. My AC is not running cold but only time will tell if the repairs are just a quick refill. I had an appointment on a Friday morning but due to some mix-up I didn't get my car until Saturday at 3:00. Had to use Uber to get around. I doubt very seriously that I will return. I honestly don't think they even looked for parts anytime on Friday.
about_p2: Greg and his assistant are the sweetest people ever. They worked with me time and time again, from when I had to have my old 2000 Mercury mountaineer completely fixed, to some minor fixing on my 95 Chevy Lumina. I don't trust anyone else with my cars and they are the first I call. Super fast as well. We have always been pleased with the service and treatment we receive at After Hours Auto Repair.

services.title: Auto repair
services.body: Vehicles are diagnosed and repaired at the actual fault before anything gets replaced.

reviews.author: Dale Hutchison
reviews.text: I suppose their work is good. My AC is not running cold but only time will tell if the repairs are just a quick refill. I had an appointment on a Friday morning but due to some mix-up I didn't get my car until Saturday at 3:00. Had to use Uber to get around. I doubt very seriously that I will return. I honestly don't think they even looked for parts anytime on Friday. And they don't even call you and let you know what's going on. The other owner was a lot more business like.

reviews.author: Brandon Whyte
reviews.text: Greg and his assistant are the sweetest people ever. They worked with me time and time again, from when I had to have my old 2000 Mercury mountaineer completely fixed, to some minor fixing on my 95 Chevy Lumina. I don't trust anyone else with my cars and they are the first I call. Super fast as well.

reviews.author: Susan Nosotti
reviews.text: We have always been pleased with the service and treatment we receive at After Hours Auto Repair. My son has brought his Honda Odessy a couple times and was happy with the service. My Sebring would not shift out of park, I had to have my car towed to After Hours Auto Repair. They had it done quickly and the price was reasonable. I would not hesitate to take my car for any repairs or maintenance back, and will recommend them to friends!

reviews.author: Mariah Mainiero
reviews.text: Brought my car in Sunday morning it was diagnosed by Sunday afternoon and fixed by Monday morning. I was originally quoted $1000 from another mechanics for said issue and only paid $300 here. Definitely a blessing. I found this place based on reviews only as we are new to the town so I’m praying he gets more and more business. Very respectful and understand gentleman.

reviews.author: Evan E
reviews.text: We are so excited to find an auto repair shop worth bragging about! Excellent service for our 2005 Toyota Sequoia - completed service the same day - 2 hours in fact!!! Gave us an honest evaluation of how the vehicle's been maintained throughout it's life, and what we need to do moving forward. Thanks for taking the stress out of vehicle maintenance!

reviews.author: Vanessa Rye
reviews.text: Greg has always given us excellent service. He uses the best products, and is still able to give a good price for his work. We will continue to use Greg and After Hours Auto Repair for our vehicles. Thanks

reviews.author: Kondinos Sopikiotis
reviews.text: Do not recommend this location! Go somewhere else!!! Every time they said my truck would be ready, they found something else wrong with it. Was a constant cat and mouse game with communication. Took over 3 weeks for them to give me an itemized invoice of the “repairs”. Taking my truck to another mechanic for a 2nd opinion. If all you need is an oil change, they should be good. Anything beyond that, look elsewhere.

reviews.author: CT H
reviews.text: Had numerous engine codes on my vehicle after a trip from another state and had to return home the next day. They were the only place that was willing to take the time to check the codes and reassure me it was ok to drive back and get it repaired. They didn’t charge me anything for spending the time to check it over. If I was staying longer I would have had them fix it.

reviews.author: Rebecca Soucey
reviews.text: First visit- Greg was kind enough to fit me in for a quick oil and filter change. Service was done in short time and I was able to wait there while work was being done. Will definitely return for next visit.

reviews.author: Benjamin Beasley
reviews.text: I contacted a slew of other shops from dealerships to the locally owned shops and by far After Hours had the best prices and turn around time. They were half the price as the others and only took less than 24 hours to get my truck back. Hands down they will get my business the next time!

reviews.author: Cyndi
reviews.text: Took my car in this morning around 10 and got it back around 3:30. I would definitely recommend this place if you have car problems. This will be my mechanic from now on... And affordable which means a lot. Thanks for the great job!

reviews.author: Cherie Grant
reviews.text: Greg was very thorough while checking over my vehicle. Fast and friendly service. I would definitely recommend After Hours Auto Repair!

reviews.author: Brian Lonie
reviews.text: After hours truly means "AFTER HOURS" as they took care of me in the dark hours of the evening when everyone else was closed. Fixed my problem in under 30 minutes. Highly recommend

reviews.author: King Biz
reviews.text: Did nothing on my truck for over two years and the refused to refund my money. Dropped off my truck paid for a new engine, two years later picked up my truck in exact same condition plus mildew and mold. Avoid! Now having to sue for refund.

reviews.author: Nicholas Leatherwood
reviews.text: I had several issues with a vehicle and After Hours handled everything exceptionally. I could not have been more pleased with the work and I will be returning for all my needs in the future.

reviews.author: Carol Sweatman
reviews.text: Greg Miller is an excellent mechanic. He will fix your car and you can trust you get a fair price for quality work.

reviews.author: Veronica Bense
reviews.text: This is the only place I’ll take my car to. Always reliable service and my car is fixed in a timely manner. The best place to take your vehicle if you have a problem.

reviews.author: Grady Sanner
reviews.text: After an incorrect self-diagnosis on my daughter's car, Greg made the correct one and the car runs great. Honest and affordable!

reviews.author: David Brungo
reviews.text: Great job and highly recommended! Hours of operation are conducive to folks who work late or long hours and they also offer pick up and drop off service, which we appreciate greatly!

reviews.author: Ray Meaux
reviews.text: Only place I found to repack wheel bearings on my trailer and fix the lights. Good work, fair prices, good service. Army veteran.

reviews.author: Scott Kaple
reviews.text: What I want in car repair--friendly, timely, and fairly priced. Glad to recommend, and I will be back when service is needed.

reviews.author: Charles Dugan (SCarecrow)
reviews.text: Mr Greg got my expedition back on the road with a new transmission fast and at a great price. Thank you.

reviews.author: Michael Sciannamea
reviews.text: finally think that I found that honest experienced mechanic after 15 years of living in Charleston..thanks Greg
